messages:
maya: quick heads-up — link-scan flagged ~24 deprecated shortlinks and 3 broken screenshots on the KB. biggest hit is the 'deploying-private' how-to (customers land here). can we do an ownership sweep and a tiny screenshot patch today? @sam @lia :eyes:
jonathan: can you paste the filenames/anchors so folks know what to grab?
maya: sure — pasted list below (from the scanner). please use the shortlink id to search in the repo:```
kb/deploying-private.md#s3-setup-shortlink-4721
kb/api-auth-guide.md#rotating-keys-shortlink-1830
kb/observability/metrics.md#prometheus-quickstart-shortlink-992
kb/deploying-private.md#screenshot-step-3-broken (x3 variants)
```
maya: priority = screenshots in deploying-private > shortlinks in auth/observability. screenshots block the flow on the first page. :warning:
lia: I can take the deploying-private screenshots. do I need any special creds or a reproducible test env?
sam: I can handle creating redirects for the shortlinks (S3 -> canonical KB urls). I just need the mapping table and a PR with the canonical paths. I have deploy rights to the CDN.
maya: thanks! mapping table: add a column for old_shortlink, new_path, author. i'm going to make an initial PR with suggested canonical paths in the docs repo and assign.
jonathan: @maya please include the CDN path for the fixed screenshots (we should upload new images under `assets/kb/deploying-private/` and reference them by sha filename). small script suggestion:```bash
# upload and print new filename
aws s3 cp build/screenshots/step3.png s3://kb-assets/assets/kb/deploying-private/ --acl public-read 
# then use the returned key as the src
```
lia: noted. i'll take screenshots on Monday morning, upload to the path above, and open a docs PR with updated markdown references. can someone do a quick editorial pass? i'm short on time that day. :coffee:
kb-bot: automated link-scan report attached. 24 deprecated links found. severity: medium. report_id=lk-2026-1934. https://internal.kb/reports/lk-2026-1934
maya: tagging this P0->P1 for scheduling (not a site outage). target: screenshot PR merged by Mon EOD, redirects live by Tue. @sam can you confirm you can do redirects Tue morning?
sam: yes — i can schedule CDN redirect job for Tue AM. i'll also post the redirect mapping as a CSV in the PR.
jonathan: once screenshots & redirects are in, let's add a short inline deprecation banner at the top of affected pages so external links don't 404 in the meantime. tiny MD snippet:```
> **Note:** This page previously referenced deprecated shortlinks. We're rolling out redirects — if you hit a 404, ping #docs and we'll patch quickly.
```
maya: perfect. i'll add that banner in the PR as well. will assign reviewers: @jonathan and @sam. thanks everyone. :tada:
lia: on it. i'll drop a draft PR link here when ready.
maya: closing loop: please add your PR link in this thread and update the report (report_id) when done so SRE/Support can mark the customer hits as mitigated. cheers! :rocket:
